decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line with several models and no sign of a shortfall, organizational slack supports keeping it while results build.
Its limited web presence and overlap with the flagship insole keep drop risk moderate, but slack supports carrying it while results remain uncertain.
Its own page signals strategic priority and likely above-aspiration performance, making discontinuation unlikely.
Fire and rescue boots fit the protective niche with no evidence of a shortfall, so slack supports continuing them.
As the home-page flagship and stated direction of the firm, it is highly unlikely to be taken off the market.
